name: How does GEO optimization differ from standard SEO?

mainEntity.name: How does GEO optimization differ from standard SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: While standard SEO aims to improve overall website visibility for broad keywords, GEO optimization specifically targets local search results and geographical relevance. Standard SEO might focus on keywords like 'digital marketing services,' whereas GEO optimization focuses on establishing your business as an entity providing 'digital marketing services in New York City.' It emphasizes local citations, Google Business Profile optimization, and creating location-specific content to ensure search engines understand your physical presence and service areas, leading to better local pack rankings and targeted customer engagement.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO optimization focuses on local search results and geographical relevance, enhancing how search engines understand your physical business locations and service areas, unlike standard SEO's broader keyword focus.
